'''Riddem''' was a [[Redarm]] in [[Matrim Cauthon]] [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
After the Band sets up camp a league outside [[Caemlyn]], Riddem was murdered by the ''[[gholam]]'' while guarding Mat's tent.
==Trivia==
Riddem is named for Tim Riddell, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
